decisions.reason: The award-winning hipress probe has strong early validation in a growing geothermal market, and it builds on existing tube production, so the option remains valuable and cheap to hold.
The single-U probe is a standard, low-cost extension of the established geothermal tube line, and the market's prospects are still unfolding, so keeping it costs little.
The surface technology supports the geothermal probe family at little marginal cost, and nothing suggests its value has failed to materialize.
Fire-protection profile systems sit close to the core steel-profile business and face regulation-driven demand, so carrying them costs little.
Slim steel profiles are a core-adjacent offering with ongoing architectural demand, and there is no evidence that the option has resolved negatively.
The decorative surface system is somewhat more niche, but it uses existing profile production, so the cost of keeping it is low while demand remains uncertain.
